notes.title: Dark Fantasy Warriors Major Update
notes.content:
Hi, and we are super glad to announce that we just made biggest game update - Dark Fantasy Warriors
Many of you asked to fix and add some elements and we did that!
First of all, we fixed some bugs in main menu and in the game. Secondly, we added exit button to main menu. Lastly, we added beta support of controller in Dark Fantasy Warriors

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260789/c3160dcd8c17f09d3ce4c15dd593eba4c2116ca3.png[/img]

Enjoy your game!
